tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and card fill. ink, ink-muted and brand text sit on it.

tokens.name: surface-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet bands (news strip, FAQ background); separates sections without a border. ink and ink-muted on it.

tokens.name: surface-sky
tokens.usage: Large rounded section panels holding white cards. ink text on it (9.5:1 / 8.7:1). brand on it is only 3.1:1: use it for 24px+ display text at most, never body.

tokens.name: surface-periwinkle
tokens.usage: Second panel colour, alternating with surface-sky. ink text on it (8.5:1 / 9.6:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The logo navy (the “Senpai” of the wordmark). Headlines and body text on surface, surface-soft, brand-soft and both panels.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, dates, nav. On surface, surface-soft and brand-soft (5.2:1+). Not on the panels in light (4.0:1 on surface-sky).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline borders on cards, inputs and dividers.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: The logo blue (the “Net” and the cap). Primary buttons, links, English display headings, icons. on-brand text on it 4.5:1 / 7.0:1; brand text on surface 4.5:1.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills; brand-coloured text on brand-soft (5.7:1+) and small links.

tokens.name: brand-bright
tokens.usage: Top colour of the app icon gradient. Illustrations, icon fills and decorative shapes only; white text on it is 3.6:1, so no text.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted chips, tag fills, icon backgrounds, selected rows. Text on it: ink, or brand-deep.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand, brand-deep and accent-strong fills.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Coral accent for small highlights (a “NEW” dot, illustration details). Never put text on it (white 2.6:1); use accent-strong for coral buttons.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: The one coral CTA per screen, e.g. 「先輩に相談する」, with on-brand text (4.9:1 / 7.7:1).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Yellow spot colour for illustrations and charts only; no text on or in it.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset around every interactive element; 4.5:1 on surface in both themes.

families.display: Lexend, "Zen Kaku Gothic New", "Noto Sans JP", sans-serif
families.heading: "Zen Kaku Gothic New", "Noto Sans JP", "Hiragino Sans", "Yu Gothic UI", Meiryo, sans-serif
families.sans: "Noto Sans JP", "Hiragino Sans", "Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN", "Yu Gothic UI", Meiryo, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: English section titles (About, Senpai, Flow, FAQ) in brand, with a small Japanese label above in eyebrow.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Numbered English labels and the Japanese label above a display-xl title, brand colour.

styles.name: hero
styles.sample: その悩み、先輩に相談しよう
styles.usage: Hero copy in Zen Kaku Gothic New: two short lines broken at 、. Set font-feature-settings "palt".

styles.name: h2
styles.sample: 進路の悩みを、経験者に。
styles.usage: Section headline in ink, Zen Kaku Gothic New with "palt"; one key phrase may take brand.

styles.name: h3
styles.sample: こんなことを相談できます
styles.usage: Sub-section and panel titles, Zen Kaku Gothic New.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Titles inside white cards and senpai names, Zen Kaku Gothic New.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: 同じ学校を卒業した先輩が、あなたの質問に答えます。
styles.usage: Paragraphs in Noto Sans JP; line height 1.87 for Japanese, no palt (keep full-width spacing for reading).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: 受験や留学、学部選びについて気軽に相談できます。

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Dates, notes, legal text in ink-muted.

type.note: Japanese: headings in Zen Kaku Gothic New (soft, modern kana that sit well beside the rounded wordmark), body in Noto Sans JP (widest kanji coverage for names and the most legible at 13–15px). Latin display in Lexend. All from Google Fonts.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Tight stacks: eyebrow to heading.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding inside small controls; card inner gap.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between a heading block and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Panel padding (surface-sky blocks).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Gap between panels.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between page sections.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom air.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Square arrow buttons, small chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: White cards and rectangular buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large section panels and hero image frames.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill CTAs and tags.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting white cards and the news strip.

tokens.name: shadow-cta
tokens.usage: Pill CTAs in the hero only.
